            return b;

            let result = dyn_slide_128(
                self.cvt_to_bytes_f32x4(a).val.0,

                val: crate::support::Aligned128(result),
                simd: self,

        }
    }

        v128_bitselect(a.into(), intermediate, b_is_nan).simd_into(self)
